subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing how an author organizes ideas across a longer informational text (comparison, problem/solution, cause/effect)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts paragraph summaries into an organizational-pattern flowchart
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a text's structure to the correct graphic organizer shape
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the organizational structure of a given longer informational text and explains why the author chose it

misconception_flags: identifies the topic correctly but misidentifies the actual organizational pattern used

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
